verdict.rationale: Adyen's Disputes API covers the evidence side of the story: merchants can retrieve dispute information, defend or accept disputes, and upload defense documents. The webhook docs describe only generic asynchronous outcome messages and never mention chargebacks, so chargeback notification is not shown. Missing for 10: documented chargeback or dispute notifications (a webhook event or alert), any mention of defense deadlines or due-date tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can get notified of chargebacks and submit dispute evidence before the deadline

citations.quote: You can retrieve dispute information, defend or accept disputes, and upload defense documents.
